For a 4-night business stay, these are three practical options:

Radisson Hotel Gurugram Udyog Vihar — around ₹7,500–9,000/night. Strong for Udyog Vihar/Cyber City access; breakfast, Wi-Fi and free-cancellation rates are available depending on package. 
MakeMyTrip

Hyatt Regency Gurugram — around ₹8,000–10,000/night. Better suited to NH-48/Manesar-side meetings, with a larger full-service business-hotel setup. 
The Gurugram House

Lemon Tree Premier, City Center, Gurugram — around ₹4,000–6,000/night. More budget-conscious, centrally located in Sector 29; breakfast and cancellation depend on the selected rate. 
Goibibo

Check before paying: breakfast inclusion, exact cancellation deadline, GST invoice eligibility, and whether Wi-Fi is complimentary.
